necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks accompanied by palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology. To correlate these neurological symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment. This service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis codes I49.9 and G45.9.
